bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2024. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3) quality is good. The 31-Dec-2024 comparative (total assets 9,243,044,811; total liabilities 23,058,030,882; equity -13,814,986,071; deposits 11,196,711,752; investments 7,415,877,482; off-balance-sheet 206,990,313) matches this dataset's own 2024_Q4.json exactly on every field, and the Mar-2024 comparative P&L column matches 2024_Q1.json's own figures exactly (investment income 47,680,744; total operating income -44,404,489; PAT -138,922,003; EPS -0.21; NOCFPS -1.40). UNEXPLAINED EQUITY-ROLLFORWARD GAP (flagged, not reconciled): this quarter's own reported net loss after tax is BDT -98.16m, yet total equity IMPROVED (became less negative) from -13,814,986,071 (Dec-2024) to -13,622,333,322 (Mar-2025), a positive movement of +192.65m -- the opposite direction implied by a loss-making quarter with unchanged paid-up capital and 'Other reserve'. The gap (+192.65m equity improvement + 98.16m reported loss = ~290.8m) is consistent in size with an unrecorded/undisclosed 'Prior year adjustment' to the opening 1-Jan-2025 equity that is not reflected in this filing's own Dec-2024 comparative column -- the same kind of comparative-vs-Statement-of-Changes-in-Equity mismatch already documented for this bank in 2018 (see 2018_Q2.json/2018_Q3.json), though the Statement of Changes in Equity table itself was too badly garbled by OCR in this filing to read a specific adjustment line and confirm the amount directly. The subsequent 2025_Q2 filing's own H1-2025 equity roll-forward (Dec-2024 to Jun-2025) reconciles cleanly and exactly to the reported H1 net loss with no such gap, suggesting this was an isolated quirk affecting the Q1 filing specifically (or its comparative column) rather than a persistent restatement. Both the Mar-2025 balance sheet (independently self-consistent: paid-up + statutory + other reserve + retained earnings = reported equity, exactly) and the P&L chain (A-B=C, C-D=PBT with D=0 this quarter, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.15) are internally consistent on their own terms; only the QUARTER-OVER-QUARTER movement between them doesn't add up.
